newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stocks seen mixed, focus on Seodarpo.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stocks seen mixed, focus on Seodarpo.

text.p: Jakarta stocks are seen mixed on Monday, with state-owned Danareksa's plan to acquire small distributor Soedarpo seen boosting sentiment on small stocks, brokers said.
"A lack of fresh factors usually prompts local speculators to look for rumours which could boost sentiment on certain small stocks," one broker said.
"The acquisition report is just the thing that the market needs today to boost sentiment on small stocks," he said.
Financial firm Danareksa said on Monday it planned to acquire a 51-percent stake in Soedarpo.
Stocks which were likely to attract attention included Timah on reports it had cancelled a plan to acquire Australian mining firm Ross Mining which has operations in Papua New Guinea, brokers said.
On Friday, the Jakarta composite index rose 4.78 points, or 0.75 percent, to close at 637.59 points.
